name: Dream Palette
source:
The main character, Max, is living his best life until he starts having strange dreams that are almost indistinguishable from reality.

And the most important thing is that he cannot sleep because of them. He wakes up as if he hadn't slept at all, and every day it gets worse...

[Translated from [url=https://lassia.itch.io/dream-palette]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角麦克斯过着最美好的生活，直到他开始做一些与现实几乎无法区分的奇怪梦。

最重要的是，他因为他们而无法入睡。他一觉醒来就好像根本没睡一样，而且情况一天天变得更糟……

[译自[url=https://lassia.itch.io/dream-palette]itch.io[/url]]
